task.spec:
I would like you to implement a module named TopModule with the following
interface. All input and output ports are one bit unless otherwise
specified.

 - input  a
 - input  b
 - output q

The module should implement a combinational circuit. Read the simulation
waveforms to determine what the circuit does, then implement it.

  time  a  b  q
  0ns   0  0  0
  5ns   0  0  0
  10ns  0  0  0
  15ns  0  0  0
  20ns  0  0  0
  25ns  0  1  0
  30ns  0  1  0
  35ns  1  0  0
  40ns  1  0  0
  45ns  1  1  1
  50ns  1  1  1
  55ns  0  0  0
  60ns  0  0  0
  65ns  0  1  0
  70ns  0  1  0
  75ns  1  0  0
  80ns  1  0  0
  85ns  1  1  1
  90ns  1  1  1
task.constraints: SystemVerilog, single self-contained TopModule DUT; xczu3eg-sbva484-1-e; 5 ns synthesis clock; simulator seed 1. No reference dependencies, hierarchy outside the DUT, file access, includes or DPI.
